title: sysupdate: by default, when writing verity sig partition, zero fill till end of partition

target.summary: When BLKZEROOUT fails with EBUSY (which occurs when dirty pages cannot be invalidated, such as when another partition on the device is in use), blockdev_zero_out() fails immediately instead of falling back to writing zeroes manually. This causes the zeroing operation to abort unexpectedly on active block devices.
notes: faulty error check that returns immediately on EBUSY instead of falling back to writing zeroes manually
definition of blockdev_zero_out whose error handling behavior is wrong
